parts:
Dear all

In Deducer 0.4.2 under R 2.14 in Win 7 there is no axis font change

Is there any reason for that?

Please your help.

Best regards
Robert

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Axis font size
parts:
font size is not supposed to change when resizing (this is an R thing
not a Deducer thing). If you want to change the font size, you can do
so in opts.

Best,
Ian
